speaker: old_maud
text: Sit down, dearie. I've waited a hundred years, I can wait while you sit.
renderText: Sit down, dearie. I've waited a hundred years, I can wait while you sit.

speaker: old_maud
text: Warm hands and empty heads. Ask yourself why, dearie.
renderText: Warm hands and empty heads. Ask yourself why, dearie.

speaker: old_maud
text: The river remembers. Ask it nicely and it might tell you.
renderText: The river remembers. Ask it nicely and it might tell you.

speaker: old_maud
text: You've the right sort of face for questions. Ask me a better one.
renderText: You've the right sort of face for questions. Ask me a better one.

speaker: old_maud
text: Oh, never get old, dearie. It's dreadful. Wouldn't miss it, mind.
renderText: Oh, never get old, dearie. It's dreadful. Wouldn't miss it, mind.

speaker: old_maud
text: Mind the bank. It's softer than it was. Everything's softer than it was.
renderText: Mind the bank. It's softer than it was. Everything's softer than it was.

speaker: old_maud
text: Never touched a shard. Not once. That's why there's still all of me.
renderText: Never touched a shard. Not once. That's why there's still all of me.

speaker: old_maud
text: Took you long enough. A hundred years I've sat here, and finally somebody comes knocking with a sensible face.
renderText: Took you long enough. A hundred years I've sat here, and finally somebody comes knocking with a sensible face.

speaker: old_maud
text: Go on, then. Ask me. Everybody asks the wrong thing, so I'll forgive you the first one.
renderText: Go on, then. Ask me. Everybody asks the wrong thing, so I'll forgive you the first one.

speaker: old_maud
text: Ah, there's my quiet neighbour. Never warmed your hands at the wrong fire, did you? That's why you can still think.
renderText: Ah, there's my quiet neighbour. Never warmed your hands at the wrong fire, did you? That's why you can still think.

speaker: old_maud
text: I told you a name once. You wrote it down, I watched you. Kept it safe, have you?
renderText: I told you a name once. You wrote it down, I watched you. Kept it safe, have you?

speaker: old_maud
text: Corvin! Still counting his missing years, is he? Good boy. Reads by the wrong lamp, but a good boy.
renderText: Corvin! Still counting his missing years, is he? Good boy. Reads by the wrong lamp, but a good boy.

speaker: old_maud
text: Did you now. She and I are the last two in this valley who remember what we were told. Mind you keep her breathing.
renderText: Did you now. She and I are the last two in this valley who remember what we were told. Mind you keep her breathing.

speaker: old_maud
text: Oh, dearie. She was the other one. The other one who still remembered. Now there's only me, and I'm tired.
renderText: Oh, dearie. She was the other one. The other one who still remembered. Now there's only me, and I'm tired.

speaker: old_maud
text: Seven years old, I was, and up past my bedtime. The sky went red over the Keep, and the stars came down.
renderText: Seven years old, I was, and up past my bedtime. The sky went red over the Keep, and the stars came down.

speaker: old_maud
text: It didn't fall, dearie. It was thrown.
renderText: It didn't fall, dearie. It was thrown.

speaker: old_maud
text: Falling things tumble. This came down straight, like a stone from a hand. Hissed in the river all night long.
renderText: Falling things tumble. This came down straight, like a stone from a hand. Hissed in the river all night long.

speaker: old_maud
text: And I'll tell you something else, since you've a sensible face. I saw who was standing on the hill when it came down.
renderText: And I'll tell you something else, since you've a sensible face. I saw who was standing on the hill when it came down.

speaker: old_maud
text: That one. Same hood. Same face under it. A hundred years, and not one day older. I was seven, dearie, not blind.
renderText: That one. Same hood. Same face under it. A hundred years, and not one day older. I was seven, dearie, not blind.

speaker: old_maud
text: If I knew that, dearie, I'd not have spent a century watching the water. Ask them. They'll answer you sideways.
renderText: If I knew that, dearie, I'd not have spent a century watching the water. Ask them. They'll answer you sideways.

speaker: old_maud
text: I never once warmed my hands at that fire in the river. Think on why I'm the one who remembers.
renderText: I never once warmed my hands at that fire in the river. Think on why I'm the one who remembers.

speaker: old_maud
text: Go on. Come back when you've better questions. I'll still be here. It's the one thing I'm good at.
renderText: Go on. Come back when you've better questions. I'll still be here. It's the one thing I'm good at.

speaker: old_maud
text: The boy is by my fire. Let his father know. As for that old bear… hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.
renderText: <Ancient, papery, unhurried; lucid concern under the cackle. No grand revelation. Mood: sad.> The boy is by my fire. Let his father know. As for that old bear… hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.

delivery.direction: Ancient, papery, unhurried; lucid concern under the cackle. No grand revelation.

speaker: old_maud
text: Poor old thing. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. No, dearie. Keep the claw. There is nothing else down there to carry home.
renderText: <Ancient, papery, unhurried; a small grief, without explaining its cause. Mood: sad.> Poor old thing. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. No, dearie. Keep the claw. There is nothing else down there to carry home.
